description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git branch' command functionalities and behaviors. It includes setup, various test cases for local and remote branches, formatting, sorting, color display, worktree handling, and other options related to git branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success showing a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two outputs/files and expects them to be identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after a test for cleanup.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color escape sequences in output.

methods.name: test_terminal
methods.description: Simulates a tty terminal for testing color output.
